positions.stakeholder_concern: The commenter is concerned that any new evaluation pathway for GenAI-enabled devices could bypass established device development and quality practices, specifically formal requirements and specifications and definitive verification and validation testing.
positions.requested_fda_action: Require that no device be cleared for marketing unless the manufacturer has followed existing Good Practices, including formal requirements/specifications and documented verification and definitive validation tests and procedures, in addition to any GenAI-specific framework.
positions.public_summary: Commenter states that no device should be cleared without adherence to existing good practices, including formal requirements and specifications and definitive verification and validation testing, implying any GenAI evaluation framework must supplement rather than replace these established requirements.
positions.source_passage: No medical device should be cleared for marketing without following Good Practices already in place including but not limited to establishing formal requirements and specifications as well as verification and and formal and definitive validation tests and procedures.
